carries: one pool of recipes, each a meal or a snack; breakfasts and desserts are snacks; no batches, no window
publishing writes a public catalogue with each recipe's allergens and an adaptability matrix from the engine, and one body file per recipe
the server serves the catalogue to everyone and a body only when free or subscribed; a refused request sends nothing, tested on a live instance

each device follows its own sequence: a seed, a day zero, a meal and a snack per day, a sixteen-week rotation with a whole-pool fallback while the pool is small, the first two weeks from the free recipes, past days frozen
the hero is today's meal; every week shows its days, a locked recipe with its name and a verdict from the matrix
search runs its four cuts over what the account can open: the free tier and its two weeks, or the whole pool for a subscriber, whose sync fetches every body
the cycle, the manual import and the gaps report feed and measure the pool against 112 meals and 112 snacks
a JavaScript twin of the sequence proves its four properties in the suite
